name: __APP_SLUG__-api
//deps-note: prisma CLI lives in dependencies on purpose. The Dockerfile installs with npm ci --omit=dev, and the container CMD runs node scripts/db-migrate.js, which calls npx prisma migrate deploy at boot. As a devDependency the CLI would be missing from the image and npx would fetch an unpinned one. feedback_prisma_cli_stays_in_dependencies.
//overrides-note: Forces patched versions of 2 transitive deps with security advisories, nested under the prisma CLI's own dependency tree (deepmerge-ts stack-exhaustion DoS via @prisma/config, mysql2 auth-downgrade + decompression-bomb DoS). Neither is ever exercised at runtime (Postgres-only, no MySQL, no Prisma streams). Every new satellite minted from this template inherits the fix on day one. Checked 2026-09-12: the newest stable prisma, 7.10.0 (2026-08-25), still pins deepmerge-ts 7.1.5 (advisory: <8.0.0) and mysql2 3.15.3 (advisories: <=3.23.0), so those two overrides are still needed; 8.0.0 is still a release candidate. fast-uri override removed 2026-09-12: ajv's ^3.0.1 range resolves fast-uri 3.1.7, which has no open advisory. feedback_prisma_transitive_cve_overrides.
